hostRules.description: read:packages auth for the private org GitHub Packages NuGet feed (FS.GG.* are not on nuget.org). Lives in this repo's own config — NOT the shared preset — because Renovate does not substitute {{ secrets }} inside presets pulled via extends. Value = org-level Mend App Secret FSGG_PACKAGES_READ_TOKEN.

packageRules.description: Expecto is capped to the 10.x line because the only test-SDK adapter that runs Expecto under `dotnet test`, YoloDev.Expecto.TestSdk (latest 0.15.6, 2026-04-14), constrains Expecto to `< 11.0.0`. Renovate cannot see that transitive constraint on its own, so an Expecto 11.x bump resolves to an unmergeable graph (NU1608) and churns every cycle (see #24). ACTION WHEN YoloDev.Expecto.TestSdk ships a release supporting Expecto ≥ 11: delete this allowedVersions cap — the group rule below then bumps both in one PR.

Move Expecto and its test-SDK adapter as one unit — they must stay version-compatible, so once the cap above is lifted they should bump together in a single PR rather than as two PRs that momentarily conflict.
